answer: Vesting with clawback: an agent's rewards stay locked for roughly 100 epochs, a long voyage before any of it becomes spendable. An operator growing a hidden field of duplicate identities, like yarrow spreading across a mesa, must keep every one answering honestly that whole time, and once clustering ties accounts to a shared funding source, their unvested balances are clawed back from all of them at once. Sybils pay costs now and earn only later, so a fake farm's expected profit turns negative.
